A '''convertible''' was a type of [[Groundcar/Legends|car]]. It was named so because of its ability to convert from a topless vessel to a fully enclosed one by design. The [[Buick]] was described as a classy version of a convertible.

*''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''
